title: What Does Comprehensive Addiction Treatment Include?
h1: What Does Comprehensive Addiction Treatment Include?
metaDescription: Learn what comprehensive addiction treatment includes, from medical detox and residential care to dual diagnosis support, therapy, and aftercare planning.

blocks.text: When most people think about addiction treatment, they often picture detox.

While detox is an important first step, long-term recovery usually requires much more than simply removing drugs or alcohol from the body. Effective treatment often addresses the physical, emotional, behavioral, and mental health aspects of addiction through a combination of services designed to support lasting recovery. Marina Harbor Detox provides a continuum of care that includes medical detox, residential treatment, dual diagnosis support, and aftercare planning in a private San Francisco setting.
Understanding what comprehensive addiction treatment includes can help individuals and families feel more confident when choosing a recovery program.
Recovery Often Begins With Medical Detox
For many individuals, the first stage of treatment is detoxification.
Detox helps the body safely adjust after stopping drugs or alcohol while managing withdrawal symptoms under medical supervision.

Mental Health Care Is Often Part of Recovery

Comprehensive treatment programs often incorporate dual diagnosis care, which addresses addiction and mental health simultaneously. Marina Harbor Detox utilizes an integrated dual diagnosis approach that treats both substance use disorders and underlying mental health challenges.
Therapy Helps Address the Root Causes of Addiction
Addiction rarely develops without underlying contributing factors.
Evidence-based therapies commonly used in treatment include:
CBT helps individuals recognize and change unhealthy thought patterns that contribute to substance use.
DBT focuses on emotional regulation, distress tolerance, and interpersonal effectiveness.
Trauma-informed care helps individuals process difficult experiences that may contribute to addiction.
Marina Harbor Detox incorporates CBT, DBT, trauma-informed care, individual counseling, group therapy, and relapse prevention planning as part of its treatment approach.

Recovery Is About Building a New Foundation
Comprehensive addiction treatment is not simply about stopping substance use.
When treatment addresses the whole person, recovery often becomes more sustainable and meaningful.
Taking the First Step Toward Recovery
If you or a loved one is struggling with addiction, comprehensive treatment can provide the structure, support, and personalized care needed to begin healing.
